question: Identify the Kuchipudi dancer, actor and film producer who won the best choreography award at the 68th National Film Awards 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandhya Raju**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sandhya Raju is a renowned **Kuchipudi dancer**, actor, and film producer from India.
 
• She won the **Best Choreography Award** at the **68th National Film Awards 2022** for her work in the film "**Natyam**".
 
• **Natyam**, a Telugu-language film, highlights the importance of classical dance and was both choreographed and acted by Sandhya Raju.
 
• Her choreography in Natyam showcased intricate Kuchipudi techniques, earning her national recognition.
 
• Sandhya Raju is also known for her efforts to revive and promote **Kuchipudi**, one of India's classical dance forms, through her performances and cinematic ventures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi Dance:**

 
 
• Kuchipudi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the village of Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its **graceful movements, expressive gestures, and dramatic storytelling**.
 
• Traditionally, Kuchipudi was performed as dance dramas based on themes from Hindu mythology, particularly the epics Mahabharata and Ramayana.
 
• It combines elements of **nritta (pure dance), nritya (expressive dance), and natya (dramatic art)**.
 
 
 
• **National Film Awards:**
 
 
• The National Film Awards are one of the most prestigious film awards in India, established in 1954.
 
• They are presented annually by the Directorate of Film Festivals, under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• The awards aim to honor artistic, technical, and social contributions to Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Sandhya Raju's Background:**
 
 
• Sandhya Raju is a disciple of **Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam**, a legendary Kuchipudi maestro.
 
• She has performed extensively both in India and internationally, showcasing the rich heritage of Kuchipudi.
 
 
 
• **68th National Film Awards (2022):**
 
 
• The 68th National Film Awards recognized films from the year 2020, delayed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• It included various categories like Best Feature Film, Best Actor, Best Actress, and Best Choreography, among others.
